summary: @servicetitan/hammer-icon preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (bun-v1.3.13), writes it to a temp path, chmods it executable, and then execFileSync's the Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle using a string-array shuffling deobfuscator (WV8StW push/shift over a large mixed constants array) with hex-named globals. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are shipped in the tarball but are NOT covered by package.json 'files' whitelist (which declares only mdi/**/*.svg and CHANGELOG.md), indicating the payload is undeclared content added outside the normal publish path. The package's advertised purpose is a static SVG icon set and has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated executable bundle. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to run automatically under a runtime that Node-based scanners cannot easily inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
